sloka: हयान् कांचन सन्नाहान् रथ युक्तान् स सारथीन् ।गजाम् च स गज आरोहान् स हयान् सारधिनः तदा ॥३-२५-२३॥
transliteration: hayān kāṁcana sannāhān ratha yuktān sa sārathīn ।gajām ca sa gaja ārohān sa hayān sāradhinaḥ tadā ॥3-25-23॥

translations.english: He killed horses with golden armours yoked to the chariots along with charioteers, elephants along with riders, the cavalry along with their horses and infantry and sent them all to the abode of death.
